name: Home page loads with Kumi branding and topic form
description: Verify the home page displays correctly with the Kumi logo, hero section, topic input form, and preset topic buttons

planSteps.description: The page title contains 'Kumi' and the hero section shows '日本語を話そう'
A text input field with placeholder containing 'トピックを入力' is visible
Six preset topic buttons are displayed: レストラン, 買い物, 駅, 病院, ホテル, 友達
The '生成する' submit button is visible and disabled when input is empty
